opportunity: An unsigned 64x64->128 multiply costs two 16-byte locals per site whose entire content is the operand. On coreutils fmt -O2 that is 23 of 298 non-thunk declarations (7.7%), and 20 of the 28 declarations of `xstrtoumax` alone. The signed form of the same computation has never had this, because IMUL lowers through `sext` and `INT_SEXT` is not in `RulePieceStructure`'s op list.
inspiration: coreutils fmt -O2 xstrtoumax; IDA prints the same expression as one __int128 multiply

root_cause.type_fallback: a 16-byte Varnode has no primitive type, so TypeFactory::get_base(16, TYPE_UNKNOWN) returns the width fallback undefined1[16]
root_cause.gate: Datatype::is_piece_structured is `metatype <= TYPE_ARRAY` (substrate/dtype.rs:1152), so the array qualifies
root_cause.rewriter: RulePieceStructure (p3_dataflow/ruleaction_6.rs, C++ ruleaction.cc:7488) converts the INT_ZEXT to a PIECE and marks the output a partial root; P6 base_explicit declares a proto-partial root
root_cause.why_signed_is_clean: IMUL lowers through `sext` (ia.sinc:3604) and CPUI_INT_SEXT is not in RulePieceStructure::get_op_list

benchmark.note: Exactly neutral, as predicted: decbench scores kuna's --json variables[] (args + stack symbols + framelayout slots), and the blobs this option removes are unique-space temporaries that are never exported there. The variables[] A/B above shows the exported type and size surface is unchanged even where a name or a line number moves.
benchmark.control_variables_ab: kuna decompile-all --json in both arms over 6 binaries (O2 coreutils fmt/sort, O2 grep, O2 gzip, O2 diffutils diff, O0 coreutils factor; 1,814 functions): 14 functions have a non-identical variables[] array. In every one of them the multiset of (kind, type, size, stack_offset, arg_index) over the array is unchanged -- 0 functions differ there -- and the only fields that move are `name`, `addresses` and `line_numbers`. That is the invariant the neutral result rests on: the scored surface (type and size per exported variable) is untouched, so no function can score differently.
benchmark.control_typesweep: the sweep's own control: 10,723 of 10,748 functions have byte-identical variables[] in both arms, and 0 of the remaining 25 scored differently

speed.method: interleaved A/B of the same release binary, `kuna decompile-all --option mulblob off|on`, one warm-up discarded; min-of-15 per target, and an order-alternated min-of-31 for anything that read above the budget. Measured on the rebased tree (fe3abc23) while other agents were using the box.
speed.fmt_O2_whole_binary_151_fns: min-of-15 read 4271.0 -> 4664.5 ms (+9.21%) with a median of -1.92%, i.e. one outlying fast off-arm run on a loaded box; the order-alternated min-of-31 re-run puts it at 4290.1 -> 4309.4 ms (+0.45%), p10 -1.32%, median 4769.5 -> 4685.0 ms (-1.77%)
speed.note: Every stable reading is at or below +0.45%, and most are negative: the pass adds one cheap predicate to RulePieceStructure and removes ops from the graph. The single above-budget number was a min taken against an off-arm outlier under load and did not survive an order-alternated re-run at n=31.
